policy: Samples from the masked softmax (as deployed), fresh LSTM state each game.
engine: coup/game.py, 1v1; seats alternate every game; seeded per game.
metric: winRate = wins / games for the evaluated model; ci95 is the 95% Wilson score interval; draws (500-turn cap) count as non-wins. avgTurns counts both players' turns.

opponents.description: RandomAgent: uniformly random legal actions; challenges 15%, blocks 25% of the time.

opponents.label: Random zoo profiles
opponents.description: ZooAgent.random_profile(): a fresh scripted personality each game (bluff, challenge, block and income rates drawn uniformly).

opponents.label: Rule-based heuristic
opponents.description: HeuristicAgent: never bluffs, always blocks when it holds the card, challenges with two copies.

belief.description: Gen 7's belief head, scored at every Gen 7 decision in the games above against the opponent's true hidden hand (20 classes: 15 two-card hands + 5 single cards). 'prior' is card counting alone: every hand consistent with the cards Gen 7 cannot see, weighted by the number of ways it could be dealt.
belief.metrics: logLoss: mean -ln p(true hand), nats. top1: most likely hand is exactly right. roleBrier: mean squared error of P(holds >= 1 of each role). reliability: role probabilities binned by prediction vs observed frequency (pooled).
